mapper.delete: with recursive tree as (select id from user_file where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0 union all select t1.id from user_file t1 inner join tree t2 on t1.parent_id = t2.id where t1.user_id = #{userId} and t1.deleted = 0 ) update user_file set deleted = #{timeStamp} where id in (select id from tree);
mapper.select: with recursive tree as (select id, file_type, file_id from user_file where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0 union all select t1.id, t1.file_type, t1.file_id from user_file t1 inner join tree t2 on t1.parent_id = t2.id where t1.user_id = #{userId} and t1.deleted = 0 ) select file_id from tree where file_type != 0;
